response.routine_note: I've removed the Glycolic Acid 10% Toner and the Benzoyl Peroxide 5% Wash because strong exfoliating and drying products are likely to aggravate skin that flushes easily and feels sensitive. Flushing, redness that lingers, little bumps and gritty eyes are best looked at by a dermatologist and an eye care professional, so I'd rather point you there than sell you something stronger.
